# mundane

> repetitive and boring; not spiritual.

> relating to the ordinary world.

> Common, ordinary, everyday

> commonplace or ordinary, lacking excitement


## Example

- *Nancy found doing dishes a thorougly mundane task, although Peter found a kind of Zen pleasure in the chore.*
